title: Cultures: Make Your Site Multilingual | Orchard Core
description:
A multilingual site starts with a decision: which languages does it support, and which one does it use when nothing asks for another? In Orchard Core, that decision is a list of cultures.

The Localization feature adds a Cultures page under Settings. You add the cultures your site supports, choose the default culture, decide whether a missing translation falls back to the parent culture, and save.

In this video:
• What a culture is, and the difference between supported cultures and the default culture
• Enabling the Localization feature in Tools, Features
• Adding cultures, choosing the default, and saving on the Cultures page
• Asking for French with the culture parameter to see a culture at work
• The localization features that build on the list, the permission, and deployment
